import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
df_offshoring = pd.read_stata('/data/offshoring_iv_mar2.dta')
df_immi = pd.read_stata('/data/immi_popimputed_00_07.dta')

# Display the first few rows of each dataset
df_offshoring.head(), df_immi.head()

# Merge the datasets on 'year' and 'beaind'
df_merged = pd.merge(df_offshoring, df_immi, on=['year', 'beaind'], how='inner')

# Display the first few rows of the merged dataset
df_merged.head()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df_merged[['iv_offshoring_1']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
y = df_merged['share_immi_imputed'].values  # Response

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficient and p-value
coefficient = model.coef_[0]
p_value = model.score(X, y)

coefficient, p_value

import statsmodels.api as sm

# Add a constant to the predictor for the regression model
X = sm.add_constant(df_merged['iv_offshoring_1'])

# Fit the regression model using statsmodels
model = sm.OLS(df_merged['share_immi_imputed'], X).fit()

# Display the summary of the regression results
model.summary()

from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor

# Calculate VIF for the predictor variable
vif_data = pd.DataFrame()
vif_data["Feature"] = df_merged.columns
vif_data["VIF"] = [variance_inflation_factor(df_merged.values, i) for i in range(len(df_merged.columns))]

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Predict the values using the model
y_pred = model.predict(X)

# Calculate residuals
residuals = y - y_pred

# Plot the residuals
plt.scatter(y_pred, residuals)
plt.axhline(y=0, color='r', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Predicted Values')
plt.ylabel('Residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Predicted Values')
